title: Countable mixed-identity-free groups embed in maximal discrete subgroups of their projective group-von-Neumann unitary groups in the trace topology
author: Vadim Alekseev; Andreas Thom
source_title: Maximal Discrete Subgroups in Unitary Groups of Operator Algebras
difficulty_reason: The proof first derives two-sided free commutator trace estimates and iterates them while retaining a positive projective lower bound. It transfers asymptotic group freeness to a tracial ultrapower, then back to nontrivial words arbitrarily near the identity, establishing a uniform discrete radius for every overgroup. That common radius is the essential new step allowing the final chain-union maximality argument in a non-locally compact unitary group.

proof_review.note: Full author Theorem3.5 core is the chain of trace computations2.1, asymptotically free sequence3.1, the complete ultrapower Lemma3.2 and approximation Lemma3.3, then Corollary3.4 and Zorn. Select countable MIF groups, making the explicit mixed-word enumeration in Lemma3.2 part of the stated scope. The metric on PU(LG) is the projective trace 2-norm, not the operator-norm topology of Section4. Prior MIF/asymptotic-freeness equivalence is background; the author supplies the new free-probability contraction and uniform-discreteness argument. The main native theorem has only a commented-out label, so the locator is its printed Theorem3.5, not an active TeX label. No hyperfinite-factor corollary or C*-norm variant is separately counted.

statement_scope: Theorem3.5 for countable MIF groups, including complete local proof supports2.1 and3.2–3.4. No C*-operator-norm variant or separate hyperfinite corollary.
